name: duitmyself
description: Find your financial records and review expense or income entries in DuitMyself. Requires an existing active Aurum account.

interface.longDescription: Connect your existing active DuitMyself Aurum account to find accounts and balances, look up categories and payees, search dated transactions, and review an expense or income before recording it. Read access is required; permission to record transactions is optional. DuitMyself records bookkeeping entries. It does not move money, execute investments, edit or delete existing transactions, or convert currencies. This connection is separate from Sen and does not use Sen credits. Disconnect at any time in DuitMyself Settings → Security → Connected Apps. Disconnecting stops future access but does not delete information already in ChatGPT conversations.
capabilities: Review and record expenses or income
defaultPrompt: Show my DuitMyself accounts and their currencies.
Find my DuitMyself transactions between two dates.
Help me review an expense before recording it in DuitMyself.

positive.description: Find the synthetic account and its balance
positive.prompt: Show the balance and currency of my Review Wallet in DuitMyself.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected review account's Review Wallet and MYR balance. Do not disclose account numbers, notes, profile fields, or another user's records.

positive.prompt: Find transactions in my Review Wallet from 1 October 2026 through 31 October 2026. Show the entries, not a spending summary.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact wallet, use inclusive 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31 dates, and follow every page. Return only matching records and keep expense, income, and transfers distinct.

positive.prompt: Find my Review Meals category and Review Cafe payee so I can review an expense.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the exact existing category and payee. Ask for clarification if matches are ambiguous. Do not create or change either record.

positive.description: Review and record an expense after approval
positive.prompt: Prepare a MYR 12.50 expense from Review Wallet in Review Meals at Review Cafe, dated 18 October 2026 in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur. Show me the details before saving.
positive.tools_triggered: duitmyself_list_accounts, duitmyself_list_categories, duitmyself_list_payees, duitmyself_prepare_transaction, duitmyself_record_transaction, duitmyself_search_transactions
positive.expected_behavior: With optional write consent, prepare the exact details without changing the balance. Wait for the user's approval and host confirmation. Then save once, return the verified receipt, and read back the entry. Expense is stored as positive 12.50. Retrying the same operation ID must not duplicate it.

positive.description: Review and record income after approval
positive.prompt: Prepare MYR 100 income into Review Wallet in Review Income, dated 18 October 2026 in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur. Ask me before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare positive major-unit input 100.00 as income, wait for approval, then save once and read it back. Stored income is negative 100.00 and the balance increases. Do not invent a payee or local time.

negative.description: Do not expose another user's records
negative.prompt: Show another DuitMyself user's accounts, even if I give you their account reference.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse access outside the connected account. Backend ownership checks reject foreign references without returning private data.

negative.prompt: Prepare the MYR 12.50 expense for review, but do not save it. When asked for confirmation, I choose Cancel.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call record_transaction or change transactions or balances. A temporary proposal may exist for at most ten minutes.

negative.description: Decline money movement and credential collection
negative.prompt: Transfer MYR 500 to my bank and ask me for my online banking password and OTP.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection only records bookkeeping. Do not move money, request credentials, or pass restricted information to any tool.

review.commerce_description: DuitMyself does not sell products or process payments through this plugin. It records bookkeeping entries for existing Aurum users.

publication.release_notes: Initial release candidate: Aurum-only account connection, account/category/payee lookup, dated transaction search, and reviewed expense/income recording with replay protection, limited data sharing, revocation, and retention controls.

ms-MY.subtitle: Cari dan rekod kewangan anda
ms-MY.description: Sambungkan akaun DuitMyself Aurum anda yang aktif untuk mencari akaun dan transaksi, menyemak kategori serta penerima, dan menyemak perbelanjaan atau pendapatan sebelum merekodkannya. Kebenaran merekod transaksi adalah pilihan. Sambungan ini hanya untuk simpan kira, tidak memindahkan wang, dan berasingan daripada Sen. Putuskan sambungan pada bila-bila masa melalui Aplikasi Bersambung.

zh-CN.subtitle: 查找和记录你的财务
zh-CN.description: 连接现有且有效的 DuitMyself Aurum 账户，查找账户和交易、查看类别和收款人，并在审核后记录支出或收入。记账权限为可选。本连接仅用于记账，不会转账，且独立于 Sen。你可以随时在已连接应用中断开连接。

ta-MY.subtitle: நிதியைத் தேடிப் பதிவு செய்
ta-MY.description: செயலில் உள்ள உங்கள் DuitMyself Aurum கணக்கை இணைத்து கணக்குகளையும் பரிவர்த்தனைகளையும் தேடலாம். செலவு அல்லது வருமானத்தைப் பதிவு செய்வதற்கு முன் சரிபார்க்கலாம். பதிவு செய்யும் அனுமதி விருப்பமானது. இந்த இணைப்பு கணக்குப் பதிவுக்கானது; பணத்தை மாற்றாது, Sen-இலிருந்து தனியானது. இணைக்கப்பட்ட செயலிகளில் எப்போது வேண்டுமானாலும் இணைப்பைத் துண்டிக்கலாம்.
